$schema: Session state manifest v3 - vertical phase slices, programmatic updates only
description: Transition the current pi-extension asset loop into a standalone TUI application that uses the Pi SDK to deterministically orchestrate the render-critique-fix loop

open_questions: Exact Usage aggregation shape from pi-ai complete()
pi-tui Image fallback behavior in non-supporting terminals
Whether bun run asset-loop needs a top-level workspace alias
key_decisions: Use Pi SDK rather than Pi extension
Each fix-step receives full context (4 images + files + 1 issue)
Batch fix, single verify per critique cycle
TUI shows inline images via pi-tui Image component
Orchestrator writes accepted.json directly (no LLM accept tool)
Critic parse failure aborts the loop
Initial gen is single SDK call with write tools
TUI surfaces iter/phase/current issue, pending issues queue, token+cost meter
Print summary and exit on termination

plan_state.summary: CP4 complete: src/tui.ts exports AssetLoopTUI — one TUI(ProcessTerminal) wired to five stacked panels (header, status line, pending-issues SelectList, side-by-side extracted/render Images, usage footer) with a narrow imperative API (start, stop, setIteration, setPhase, setIssues, setCurrentIssue, setRender, setUsage, showSummary). runAssetLoop instantiates it right after extractedBase64 and the UsageAggregator, calls tui.start()+setPhase('initial_gen'), installs a one-shot SIGINT handler that tears down the TUI and exits 130, and wraps the remainder in try{...}finally{process.off('SIGINT',handler)}. Every transition (per-iteration setIteration+setPhase('render'), setRender+setPhase('critique') after render, setIssues after critique, setPhase('fix',issue)+setCurrentIssue(i) per issue) is wired. Usage snapshots are pushed into the TUI from the initial-gen subscribe handler, after each critique (for-of on outcome.usages), and inside every runFixStep onUsage callback. Three termination sites (hit_empty, cap, parse-failure) swap CP3's stdout console.log(formatUsageSnapshot) for tui.showSummary([...])+tui.stop() (parse-failure uses stderr then tui.stop before re-throw). accepted.json + critique.json shapes unchanged. Typecheck passes.
